notes: Runner (RUNNER) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 built on the unmodified OpenZeppelin Contracts v5.4.0 ERC20 at src/Runner.sol. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 RUNNER (1000000000000000000000000000 in 18-decimal minor units) once to msg.sender, which is the launch factory; nothing can mint afterwards. Transfers move exactly the requested amount with no tax, burn, reflection, callback, pause, blacklist, freeze, owner, minter, burnFrom, seize, initializer, upgrade path, delegatecall or selfdestruct, so the factory's transfer to the MerkleDistributor, the distributor's claims, the single-sided seed through the Uniswap v4 PoolManager and ordinary swaps each move exactly what they say. There are no application contracts, no initialization calls and no linked libraries. The pool pairs with IMD (0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7) on Ethereum at the launch policy's 1.25% fee with tick spacing 60; pool.initialPrice is provenance only, and the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (5,000 IMD for the whole supply) and the token's supply. economics is the requester's, copied verbatim: 80% of the supply seeds the pool and the remainder of the requester's share goes to 0x612a9bb008e16ef2d24f41dae9fc661831d93367. The swarm's share is taken by the factory and is not described here.
